newsitem.title: USA: Cousins Properties in development venture.
newsitem.headline: Cousins Properties in development venture.

text.p: Cousins Properties Inc said on Monday that it was forming a joint venture to invest in a 278,000-square-foot office tower, as well as the development of a 415,000-square-foot tower on an adjacent site.
Cousins said when the new building is completed it will own a 50 percent interest in the two projects, which will represent a $66 million gross investment by Cousins before debt financing.
The properties are located in Atlanta's Buckhead office submarket, the company added.
Cousins added that the investment partnership joining the venture was advised by Bethesda Stonebridge Associates, which owns the existing building and the development site.
Cousins is an Atlanta-based equity real estate investment trust.
